run_drqv2_training: run the DRQv2 reinforcement learning training loop with Hydra config and DMC environments
create_workspace: create a Workspace instance that sets up training and evaluation environments with a replay buffer
eval_agent: evaluate the trained agent over multiple episodes and log episode reward and length metrics
save_snapshot: save the agent state, timer, global step, and episode count to a PyTorch snapshot file
load_snapshot: load a previously saved PyTorch snapshot to resume training from a checkpoint
